newsitem.title: UK: BAA to set 175 mln stg 7-year convertible.
newsitem.headline: BAA to set 175 mln stg 7-year convertible.

text.p: BAA Plc said on Wednesday it would issue 175 million stg convertible bonds due 2004 via joint lead managers UBS Ltd and J. Henry Schroder & Co Ltd.
The bonds will pay a semi-annual coupon of between 4.875 and 5.25 percent. The conversion price will be fixed at a premium of between 15 and 18 percent.
